rationale: The text describes conventional data connection, automation, threat response, and incident response, but “deeper insights” and “uncover hidden threats” lack a stated mechanism; the non-AI judgment remains weak and forced.
evidence_spans: IBM Cloud Pak for Security is an open security platform that connects to your existing data sources to generate deeper insights and enables you to act faster with automation. Whether your data resides on IBM or third-party tools, on-premises or multiple cloud environments, the platform helps you to find and respond to threats and risks - all while leaving your data where it is. So you can uncover hidden threats, make more informed risk-based decisions and respond to incidents faster.
conflict_response: The blind supported proposal appropriately identifies data connection, automation, and response functions, but the parent concern is material because the text gives no mechanism for its deeper-insight and hidden-threat claims. The labeler’s weak/forced treatment is retained: no affirmative AI is established, yet the unexplained claims prevent a supported non-AI negative.
